run_evaluate_cli: run the evaluate CLI to compute MSE, NMSE, PSNR, and SSIM metrics on MRI reconstruction HDF5 files
run_mse_function: run the mse function to compute mean squared error between ground truth and predicted arrays
run_nmse_function: run the nmse function to compute normalized mean squared error between ground truth and predicted arrays
run_psnr_function: run the psnr function to compute peak signal to noise ratio between ground truth and predicted arrays
review_Metrics_class: review the Metrics class that maintains running statistics for MSE, NMSE, PSNR, and SSIM across multiple samples
